name: Stephen Lewis
role: Ontario NDP leader (1970–1978), Canadian UN ambassador and international AIDS advocate
summary: Lewis advocated public social services, racial and gender equality, and substantial international assistance against AIDS. He supported stronger multilateral institutions and urgent climate policy while criticising corporate trade privileges and lender austerity.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Demands universal pharmacare alongside renewed public healthcare funding.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Rejects replacing human priorities with market imperatives.

unions-good.rationale: Insists unions help shape the renewable-energy transition.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Affirms government regulation against unchecked corporate power.

cut-welfare.rationale: Defends social security against deficit-driven dismantling.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Opposes intrusive identification and C-51’s antiterrorism powers.

state-harmful.rationale: Describes government’s protective social functions as essential.

abortion-legal.rationale: Treats abortion as a reproductive right governments wrongly avoid.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Demands comprehensive institutional action against systemic anti-Black racism.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Wants stronger UN agencies and reformed international leadership.

free-trade.rationale: Rejects free-trade agreements privileging corporations over jobs and medicines.

nation-first.rationale: Demands wealthy nations finance lifesaving treatment abroad.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Argues deployed troops could have prevented Rwanda’s genocide.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Demands urgent binding emissions commitments and renewable transition.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Calls for government investment creating alternative manufacturing jobs.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Prefers delayed balancing to destructive welfare cuts.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Personally opposed and denounced South African apartheid.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Condemns Alberta’s oil-sands development and fossil-producer influence.

proportional-representation.rationale: Explicitly demands proportional representation rather than ranked ballots.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Identifies pervasive male oppression of women in the AIDS crisis.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Recommends independent investigation and prosecution of police abuses.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Assigns government healthcare, education, pensions and employment responsibilities.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Frames equal treatment and protection as rights denied by systemic racism.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Demands resources prevent avoidable deaths among impoverished Africans.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Rejects antiterrorism legislation’s excessive erosion of civil liberties.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Drove the requirement that Waffle dissolve its separate organisation or leave the NDP.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: His book advocates cancellation of burdensome African debt.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Demands substantial binding G8 commitments against African AIDS.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Demands promised parity in senior UN appointments.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Endorses reserved admission places and employment-equity legislation.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Demands enforceable employment equity against discriminatory hiring barriers.

corporate-influence.rationale: Denounces corporate access shaping secret investment negotiations.

non-intervention.rationale: Rejects international inaction when force could stop genocide.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Rejects corporate tribunals bypassing Canadian law; supports other UN institutions.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Says feminism requires universal publicly funded childcare.

socialized-care.rationale: Demands universal public childcare with trained educators.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Treats the Holocaust as established historical atrocity.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Condemns criminalisation of homosexuality and imprisonment of gay health activists.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Insists grassroots organisations must make critical decisions.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Insists substantive divisions separate the democratic left from Liberals.

refuse-lender-austerity.rationale: Condemns imposed structural adjustment for sacrificing human development.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Affirms policing’s essential role while demanding accountable reform.

rent-control.rationale: Personally campaigned for rent control in Ontario.

local-essentials-public.rationale: Defends Medicare against privatisation by corporate entrepreneurs.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Endorses carbon taxation and praises British Columbia’s carbon tax.

future-generations.rationale: Makes grandchildren’s future a reason for climate action.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Advocates debt relief and fairer trading arrangements for Africa.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Names deficient property and inheritance laws as failures of women’s equality.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: Praises Ontario’s Women’s Directorate and champions adequately funded UN Women.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Opposes preferential pharmaceutical patents and special corporate arbitration.

racism-not-main-obstacle.rationale: Identifies systemic racism as a persistent institutional barrier.

notes: Career coverage includes Ontario leadership, the 1992 race-relations report, UN work, AIDS advocacy and later climate campaigning. The Waffle dispute concerns party organisation, not a demand to outlaw public political opposition. General LGBT advocacy does not establish specific marriage or gender-identity policies. His 2016 invitation to debate the Leap Manifesto explicitly leaves individual proposals unsettled. Reproductive-rights advocacy does not specify gestational limits. Criticism of patent privileges is not abolition of all intellectual property. Descriptions of a play’s assisted-dying debate are not his endorsement of either character. Later Gaza protest reporting does not establish his preferred constitutional settlement. No positions assigned from relatives or foundation staff. Remaining nulls reviewed across all statement themes; no inference from socialist identification.
